titleStmt.title: [Johann Konrad Ulmer (von Ulm, ab Ulmis)] / [Schaffhausen] an [Heinrich Bullinger], 7. April 1569

msItem.incipit: Quod dudum ad tuas postremas literas ... non respondi

div.p:
S. D.
